title: Design: Bill To lock tooltip shows at the window's left edge
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new work order for this test for customer B billed to customer A that has been invoiced (Invoiced or Paid), so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p3-03-after-hover.png, bt-p3-07-after-hover.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Hover over the Bill To value.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The tooltip shows under the customer card starting at the browser window's left edge and overlaps the top of the asset card.
